QuestInfo.name: Honnou-ji Infiltration 1
QuestInfo.0: Plan out the Honnou-ji infiltration with Shingen.
QuestInfo.1: Head north from Momijigahara to meet up with Sanada Yukimura. From there, climb the Eastern Honnou-ji wall and make your way to the Eastern Wing. Yukimura will watch your back.
QuestInfo.2: You and Yukimura are ready to enter Honnou-ji. Prepare for a sneaking mission!
